title: Stand and Sing of Zambia, Proud and Free

english.author: English Wikipedia contributors
english.note: Extracted from the English Wikipedia article cited in sources.local.note.

local: Stand and sing of [[Zambia]], proud and free,
Land of work and joy in unity,
Victors in the struggle for the right,
english: Stand and sing of [[Zambia]], proud and free,
Land of work and joy in unity,
Victors in the struggle for the right,

local: Fashion'd with and blessed by God's good hand,
Let us all her people join as one,
english: Fashion'd with and blessed by God's good hand,
Let us all her people join as one,

local: One land and one nation is our cry,
english: One land and one nation is our cry,

local: Like our noble eagle in its flight,
english: Like our noble eagle in its flight,

local: Praise be, praise be, praise be,
english: Praise be, praise be, praise be,

local: Under the flag of our land.
english: Under the flag of our land.
